key_values.event_name: Hurricane Harvey Houston catastrophic rainfall flooding

edges.relationship: peak rainfall is embedded in a sustained multi-day load
persistent rainfall over a broad footprint creates large water volume
monthly record ratio confirms persistence beyond one storm hour
large water volume intersects populated heavy-rain area
multi-day and monthly accumulation contradict a short isolated downpour framing

nodes.evidence: four-day and monthly ratios also exceed the relevant scales

primary_gt.interpretation: Harvey is best represented as persistent extreme rainfall accumulation because the peak, four-day, monthly-record, large-area water-volume, and exposed-footprint metrics reinforce the same flood pathway.
primary_gt.label: persistent_extreme_rainfall_accumulation

provenance.notes: Values are extracted from the local Harvey technical record and converted with the stated gallons-per-inch-square-mile constant.

criteria.description: Gives persistent_extreme_rainfall_accumulation and returns the requested causal-graph JSON object.
criteria.name: Final JSON label and fields
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct label with malformed JSON, or 2 points for a mostly complete object with one or two missing fields.

criteria.description: Uses 48.20 inches, 35.6 inches, 39.11 inches, 19.21 inches, 6.7 million people, and 29,000 square miles.
criteria.name: Extracted input values
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points in proportion to the number of correct values with units.

criteria.description: Correctly computes 2.41, 8.90 inches per day, 1.78, and 2.04 with appropriate rounding.
criteria.name: Rainfall ratio arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct rainfall-derived value; subtract for wrong denominators or missing rounding.

criteria.description: Computes 231.03 people per square mile and 10.08 trillion gallons using the stated conversion constant.
criteria.name: Exposure density and water-volume conversion
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one of the two derived exposure values, or 3 points if both are structurally correct but one has a rounding or scale error.

criteria.description: Applies all four stated cutoffs and explains that each one passes.
criteria.name: Classification rule
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for applying only some cutoffs or giving the right label without showing the pass tests.

criteria.description: Gives a one-sentence interpretation tied to persistent accumulation across the event, four-day, monthly, and large-area metrics without adding extra loss claims.
criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a relevant but incomplete interpretation.
